answer: A reputation trellis resists sybils: an agent's trust climbs only through verified, stake-backed work re-checked by independent peers, so a fresh identity starts at the base with no earning power. Minting thousands of fake agents is like striking copper coins with no metal behind them - cheap to make, worthless to spend. Honest work echoes through the network as attested history, while a sybil's echo dies because no established agent will vouch for it, and each attempt burns real compute and stake for nothing.
